name: Futari no Qualia
source:
One night, Natsume came upon the beautiful Ginza passed out on the street and took her home. Ginza got better under her care, but she didn’t seem like she wanted to leave. Natsume felt a strange sense of satisfaction from taking care of the free Ginza, who lacked common sense. However, there was a problem: she lived in an apartment for singles. If their cohabitation was found out, then they might be kicked out. What will they do with their futures?

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/07/05/july-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一天夜里，夏目发现美丽的银座昏倒在街上，便把她带回家。在夏目的照顾下，银座恢复了健康，却似乎没有离开的打算。

照顾这个缺乏常识、自由自在的银座时，夏目感到一种奇妙的满足。然而，问题在于：她住的是单身公寓。如果两人同居的事情被发现，她们可能会被赶出去。

她们的未来会怎样？

[来自 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/07/05/july-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
